name: failedDASTScanTargetsCount
definition: The number of DAST scan targets whose most recent finished scan (succeeded, failed or cancelled) failed.
population: every scan target with a finished scan in a complete read of the recent-scan list (fewer than the 100 scans one read returns), newest start time first; queued, running and paused scans are skipped
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read (fewer than 100 scans, no GraphQL errors) in which every scan has a known status and every finished scan a scan target id and readable start time; 0 only when no target's newest finished scan has status failed. No finished scan, or a full page, is not measured.

openDecisions.question: Should another DAST product (for example a different web application scanner) be allowed to answer this key, or should it stay with Burp Suite DAST until a second implementation is replayed?
positions: any (registered): every Application Security integration may answer it, held to this definition.
listed: only Burp Suite DAST until a second product's implementation is replayed against real data.

citations: safeguards/devsecops/burpsuitedast/faileddastscantargetscount.py (reads Integration-Service method listRecentScans: scans(sort_column: start, sort_order: desc) { status start_time scan_target { id } scan_failure_message })
https://portswigger.net/burp/extensibility/dast/graphql-api/scanstatus.html (failed: the scan was unable to start or was unable to finish due to errors; retrieved 2026-11-13)

changeLog.change: Registered for the PortSwigger Burp Suite DAST checks. No live server read yet, so the key is proposed and V0.

notes: A target whose newest finished scan was cancelled is not counted and is reported in additionalFindings.
